description: Sixteen trigger tracks written as hexadecimal text, four steps to a character, with 100 patterns and a chance of adding or dropping triggers

params.text: Picks which of the 100 patterns is played and edited
While on, the pattern is picked by hand and a cable in the pattern input no longer moves the selection
Copies all sixteen hex lines of the current pattern
Writes the copied hex lines into the current pattern
Pushes the patterns after the current one along by one place and empties the current one; the hundredth pattern is lost
Removes the current pattern and pulls every later pattern back one place
At 100% its track plays its written triggers; below that each written trigger has that chance of firing, and above it each step with no written trigger has the extra chance of firing
The chance that its track fires an inverted trigger on a step where nothing is written, 0 to 100%
Runs its track; while it is off that track fires nothing on either output

inputs.text: Each rising edge moves every track on by one step
A rising edge sends every track back to its first step
Selects the pattern, 0.1V per pattern over 0-10V; while it is patched the pattern cannot be picked by hand unless Edit is on

outputs.text: A 10ms trigger on a track's channel for each step that fires, sixteen channels wide
Carries 10V on a track's channel while the step it has reached fires, sixteen channels wide
Passes the clock through on a track's channel while the step it has reached fires, sixteen channels wide, despite its tooltip reading Inverted Clock
A 10ms trigger on a track's channel for each step that fires an inverted trigger, sixteen channels wide
Passes the clock through on a track's channel while the step it has reached is not firing, sixteen channels wide

notes: every line of every pattern comes up empty, so no track fires until hexadecimal digits are typed into a line or a pattern is randomised
each line is typed as hexadecimal digits, one digit to four steps, and a star in place of a digit draws a new random digit every time it is read
the number keys 1 to 9 move the cursor to that line of the pattern
menu: ShowLights — hides or shows the step lights over the text lines
Clock In Delay — holds the clock back by 0 to 10 samples, to let a pattern change arrive first
Random — opens a density slider that sets how thickly a randomise fills a line
Random length from — sets the fewest digits a randomised line is given, 1 to 16
Random length to — sets the most digits a randomised line is given, 1 to 16
Randomize Pattern — writes new random lines into the current pattern
Initialize Pattern — empties every line of the current pattern
right clicking a hex line opens that line's own menu, not the module's: Cut, Copy, Paste, Select all, and Euclidean, which writes a Euclidean rhythm of a chosen length and hit count

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
